slides.stem: A jacket is on sale for $\$51$, which represents a $15\%$ discount off the original price. What was the original price of the jacket?

slides.intro: A $15\%$ discount keeps $85\%$ of the price.
slides.trapWhy: $\$58.65$ adds $15\%$ back onto $\$51$. Adding a percent never undoes subtracting it.

slides.title: Divide by what remains
slides.body:
After a $p\%$ discount, the sale price is $(1 - p)$ of the original. Reverse it by dividing by that retention rate.

For $15\%$ off, divide by $0.85$. Never add $15\%$ back.
